When a deal does settle, it makes money. In the 18-20 slice, 241 deals settled, none below cost, median margin 9,712. Profit before losses was 11.38M on 55.0M of revenue, with 96% sell-through and no food waste. Storage cost was 101k.
The seller funnel loses deals before settlement. Of 680 negotiations, 283 completed (42.5%); 244 were canceled and 139 rejected.

hypothesis: H2 is neither confirmed nor rolled back. The sample is 701 closed negotiations. Completion is 0.42, below the 0.5 target. Losses are 0, well under the 500k rollback line.
